entry.confirm_signal: Three-tone melody, cell-count beeps (LiPo only), long beep, three-tone melody, then the beep for parameter 1
steps: Wait for: melody, cell beeps, long beep, melody, then the first parameter beep

announce.description: 8 parameters cycle without end. Parameter N is N beeps. After a parameter is selected, its settings are sounded as 1x, 2x or 3x beeps.

select.description: Parameter: throttle to stop (min) before the beep sequence of the next parameter starts. No time in ms is stated.

value_select.description: Setting: throttle up after the beep of the wanted setting. No window stated.

skip.description: Leave the throttle unchanged; the next parameter follows.

scheme.confirm_signal: Confirmation melody after a setting is adopted.
scheme.exit: Disconnect the battery. After parameter 7 or 8 is selected the ESC leaves programming mode and runs normally.
scheme.description: Throttle at max, then battery on. A melody, cell beeps, a long beep and another melody play, then parameter 1 is beeped. Eight parameters cycle; throttle to stop selects the current one; throttle up on a setting beep stores it and a melody confirms. Further parameters follow.

unknowns: Entry wait time between battery connection and the first parameter beep is not stated in ms.
Beep length and gap are not stated.
Time window for the stop gesture is not stated; the manual says only 'before the next parameter's beep'.
Whether the stick must return to max or stay at stop between selecting a parameter and choosing a setting is not stated.
BEC type (linear or switching) is not stated.
Cell count limits for XC-65-Lite: LiPo 2-6; NC/NiMH 6-18; other models LiPo 2-3 (XC-12 NC/NiMH 5-10, others 5-9).
notes: The connections text of the manual names a Roxxy BL-Control 7xx; the manual is a rebadged text. Menu and parameters are as listed here.
Item 4 threshold values are 3.0 / 3.2 / 3.4 V per cell; Nixx 0 / 50 / 60 % of initial voltage.
Dualsky_XController_Lite_programming.pdf describes a different (Hobbywing-style, 5-6-5 melody) scheme and is in dualsky-xcontroller.
